name: salt-me
description: Let your AI read your own Salt chats, decrypted on your computer, and send as you.
long_description: Runs salt-mcp --as-me: a local server that lets your AI read your own end-to-end encrypted Salt chats, decrypted on this computer, and send as you. The first use opens a page with a code; scan it with the Salt app on your phone (Menu, Devices, Link a computer) to link this computer. No password or key is typed into this bundle. Unlink from your phone (Connections) or with --unlink.
